The Watershed Remote Sensing Lab is based in [Geography, Earth and Environmental Sciences](https://www.unbc.ca/department-geography-earth-and-environmental-sciences) at the [University of Northern British Columbia](https://www.unbc.ca/). Below are the students, mentees and collaborators I currently work with, along with those who have moved on.

## Joining the lab

Prospective graduate students and undergraduates interested in hydrology, the cryosphere, remote sensing or environmental sensor design are welcome to get in touch by [email](mailto:alex.bevington@unbc.ca). Please include a short description of your interests and a CV.
